in_marathi.name: Krishnamurthy
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God-protector of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krishnamurthy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Krishna means 'black' or 'dark' and Murthy means 'god'. This name is derived from the Hindu deity Krishna, who is often depicted as the protector and preserver of wealth. Krishna is a central figure in Hindu mythology and is known for his mischievousness, love for butter, and his role as an avatar of Vishnu.
